value: Sworn in state or federal police officer
lmiWaiverProfessions.sourceTitle: Medical Professional Package | People First Bank (and Essential Services Package)
lmiWaiverProfessions.note: TWO separate packages, both waiving LMI to 90% LVR but with different loan-size ceilings. Medical Professional Package (dentists, general practitioners, hospital employed doctors, medical specialists, optometrists, pharmacists, veterinary practitioners) - LMI premium waived on loans up to $2 million. Essential Services Package (registered nurse, fully qualified paramedic, sworn in state or federal police officer) - LMI waived and "eligible essential services workers can borrow up to $1.2 million with a 90% LVR" (https://www.peoplefirstbank.com.au/loans/home-loans/essential-services-package). Both available to owner occupiers AND investors. Income requirements apply and vary between single and joint applications; on a joint application only one applicant needs to hold the qualifying occupation. New business only. Neither page carries an effective date; retrieval date used.

lmiWaiverMaxLvrPct.sourceTitle: Medical Professional Package | People First Bank
lmiWaiverMaxLvrPct.note: "With our Medical Professional Package, you can borrow up to 90% LVR and we'll waive the LMI premium for loans up to $2 million." The Essential Services Package uses the same 90% LVR ceiling.

notes.value: Owner-occupied LVR pricing bands published: <70%, 70.01%-80%, >80% (to 95%) on the Basic Variable; <80% and >80% on the fixed terms.

notes.value: Broker-originated lending IS accepted and actively courted. People First Bank runs a public broker section (peoplefirstbank.com.au/brokers) with a dedicated broker support team with embedded credit assessment, FASTRefi, DocuSign signing, Simpology electronic lodgement, BDMs, and a secure Broker Portal (accredited brokers only) where current SLA turnaround times are published.

gaps: ENTITY NOTE: the id 'peoples-choice' is retained as the join key, but People's Choice no longer exists as a separate lender. Heritage Bank and People's Choice Credit Union merged in 2023; the combined entity is Heritage and People's Choice Ltd, trading as People First Bank (ABN 11 087 651 125, ACL 244310). If a separate 'heritage-bank' record exists in this pack it is the same legal entity and the two should be reconciled.
No public credit policy guide. All broker product/policy material and SLA times are behind the secure Broker Portal login, which is out of scope under the no-login source rule.
Servicing entirely unsourced: assessment buffer, floor rate, DTI cap, rent shading, HEM basis, credit-card and HECS treatment.

No income-type policy published (casual, self-employed, overtime, bonus, commission, Centrelink, rental). The Medical and Essential Services packages reference unspecified 'income requirements' that are not published.
No employment tenure minimums, credit-history knock-outs, residency/visa rules, genuine-savings policy or guarantor policy published.
No security policy at all: no acceptable/unacceptable property types, minimum unit size, postcode category list, high-density or rural policy.
Investment-loan maximum LVR could not be captured - the published rate table exposed only owner-occupied product rows.
The rate table and product pages carry no effective/as-at date, so the retrieval date (29 July 2026) is used for every fact sourced from them.
Maximum interest-only term, bridging availability and SMSF lending are not addressed on any public page.
